description:
The affectionate F husband, Meonggun, and the chic T wife, Nyangsuni, have completely opposite personalities, but the two who have been writing their own story as a married couple are now preparing to become a 'family of three'! The Meongnyang couple are half excited and half worried about their first pregnancy and first childbirth. From preparing for the pregnancy to the OB/GYN, postpartum care, prenatal care, preparing baby supplies, and finally, the long-awaited birth...! 

We share the process of becoming parents, where nothing is easy, with all the expectant parents. Please join us in our warm daily life as we welcome a new family member!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
